title: Aureline presentation follow waypoint
description: Canonical, export-safe follow-waypoint object for an M5 presentation or walkthrough session. A waypoint is one prepared anchor in the walkthrough. It binds to a stable object on an existing Aureline surface (editor, diff, docs, graph, or notebook) — never a parallel artifact type — and preserves the provenance decorative chrome must not erase: the target object identity, file path, symbol anchor, branch/workspace context, and the local/remote/shared boundary label. reuses_existing_surface is always true and creates_parallel_artifact is always false, so a waypoint stays a thin pointer at real work. The speaker_note is governed by speaker-note.schema.json. Adding a new surface_kind, boundary_label, or completion_state value is additive-minor and requires a schema_version bump on the owning session; repurposing an existing value is breaking.
